# StepDoc

> Record it once. People read it. Agents run it. StepDoc creates editable browser workflow guides and portable agent replay files, using storage you own.

Source: https://github.com/tanzir71/stepdoc
Landing: https://tanzir71.github.io/stepdoc/
Documentation: https://tanzir71.github.io/stepdoc/site/docs/
Guide schema: https://tanzir71.github.io/stepdoc/site/docs/guide.schema.json

## Available now

- Browser extension source builds for Chrome/Edge and Firefox; install instructions are in the documentation. A store listing is not available yet.
- Local library and editor with IndexedDB/OPFS, capture, redaction layers, history, Guide Me and exports.
- Typed values are never recorded. Fill steps reference variables or secrets; values for replay are supplied at runtime.
- Redaction happens in the browser before screenshots are stored or uploaded. Servers receive only already-redacted pixels.
- guide@1 JSON, Markdown, self-contained HTML, Playwright and SKILL.md exports use the production core exporters.
- Accessible role/name targets with ordered selector fallbacks and expected results.

## Generated example

The fictional Ledgerly billing example uses an original design screenshot with blurred billing fields. It is not a live application, and its verification status is never-run. The HTML embeds its images; the other formats use the companion img/ directory.

- [Human guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/stepdoc/site/demo/)
- [guide.json](https://tanzir71.github.io/stepdoc/site/demo/guide.json)
- [guide.md](https://tanzir71.github.io/stepdoc/site/demo/guide.md)
- [replay.spec.ts](https://tanzir71.github.io/stepdoc/site/demo/replay.spec.ts)
- [SKILL.md](https://tanzir71.github.io/stepdoc/site/demo/SKILL.md)

## Target roadmap

PHP + SQLite, Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2, and the v2 Node + Postgres Storage API are in development. The existing v1 Next.js/Supabase editor remains a private single-user tool without account authentication. Do not expose that editor/API publicly.

MCP servers, WebMCP registration, passkey accounts and automatic GitHub Pages publishing are planned v2 integrations. Current exported HTML can be hosted as a static file. Target-specific documentation distinguishes current source builds from planned deployment paths.

Competitor prices on the landing were checked against public pricing pages; prices change and should be re-checked before quoting.
